OAR 141-083: Undersea Infrastructure Easements in Oregon's Territorial Sea

#### Current Stat​us

DSL is updating administrative rules (OAR 141-083) that guide how easements are issued for uses of the territorial sea​. Proposed changes are intended to strengthen protections for Oregon’s marine ecosystems, streamline permitting, and ensure fair public compensation for use of the seafloor. ​

The public comment period is now closed. DSL is reviewing comments received through September 21.

Questions? Please contact DSL.Rules@dsl.oregon.gov​.​

MHOR Homes: Correction to recently adopted Division 46 rules

Summary

The Land Conservation and Development Commission (LCDC or commission) adopted ​Oregon Administrative Rules (OARs) at their August 27, 2026 meeting for middle housing in medium and large cities to conform with updates to definitions of middle housing types as provided in House Bill 2138 (2025). This rulemaking is correcting the submission to the Secretary of State that did not reflect the rule langauge adopted by the commission.
